items.title: 8.5 Podon mein pani ki naqal (transport) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5, printed pages 184-187.

blocks.text: Jarein apni wasee shakhon se jazb ke liye bara satahi raqba (surface area) deti hain. Jar ke baal (root hairs), jar ke epidermal cells ki tawseeh, pani aur minerals lene ka zyada tar kaam karte hain. Mitti se pani aur minerals active aur passive transport se jar ke epidermal cells mein dakhil hote hain, cortex se guzarte hain aur jar ke markaz mein xylem tak pohnchte hain. Jar ke andar yeh teen mukhtalif raston se safar karte hain.

items: Apoplast rasta jar ki mutasil cell walls ke nizam se guzarne wala musalsal rasta hai. Endodermis par Casparian strips ki wajah se yeh toot jata hai.

Symplast raste mein pani aur minerals jar ke cells ke aapas mein jure protoplasts se guzarte hain, jo plasmodesmata se jure hain, yani cytoplasm ke dhaage jo mutasil cell walls ke surakhon se guzarte hain. Symplast rasta kam aham hai siwaye endodermis ke ilaqe mein minerals ke liye.

Vacuolar raste mein pani aur minerals cell membranes, cytoplasm, tonoplasts (vacuole ki jhilliyan) aur vacuoles ko paar karte hain, vacuole se vacuole tak jate hue, symplast aur apoplast ko chhor kar. Is raste se harkat na-honay ke barabar (negligible) hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch milte julte cells ki qatar, har ek mein cell wall, gulabi cytoplasm aur beech mein vacuole jis ki hadd tonoplast hai; padosi cells plasmodesmata se jure hain. Kale teer cell walls mein (apoplast), narangi teer cytoplasm aur plasmodesmata se (symplast), aur neele teer ek vacuole se doosre vacuole tak (vacuolar) chalte hain. Labels: Plasmodesmata, Tonoplast, Vacuole, Cell wall, Cytoplasm.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7: Apoplast, symplast aur vacuolar raston se pani ki harkat (kitab ki Figure 8.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen rang, teen raste: kala raasta deewaron se guzarta hai aur kisi membrane ko paar nahin karta (apoplast). Narangi raasta ek cell ke cytoplasm se plasmodesmata ke zariye agle cell ke cytoplasm mein jata hai (symplast). Neela raasta har cell ke vacuole se guzarta hai, is liye har baar tonoplast paar karna parta hai (vacuolar).

Xylem woh vascular tissue hai jo pani aur hal shuda minerals jaron se tane aur patton tak le jata hai; yeh ek aham banawati tissue bhi hai jo mechanical sahara deta hai. Yeh tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma par mushtamil hai. Tracheids lambe, patle cells hain jin ki moti lignin wali deewarein hain; un ke sire nokeele (tapered) hain aur yeh bordered pits se jure hain jo pani ko cells ke darmiyan pehlu se guzarne dete hain. Vessels chhote aur chaure hain, sira-ba-sira musalsal naliyon mein tarteeb diye gaye, jin ke siron par pani ki moassar harkat ke liye perforation plates hain. Xylem fibres moti lignin wali deewaron wale lambe cells hain, pakne par murda, jo xylem ki banawati mazbooti barhate hain. Xylem parenchyma cells zinda, patli-deewar wale cells hain jo pani aur nutrients rakhte hain, pehlu ki (lateral) naqal mein hissa lete hain aur xylem ke bharne aur dobara banne mein madad karte hain.

blocks.alt: Xylem ke chaar qism ke cells saath saath. Fibre: lamba dukla-numa (spindle) cell, moti deewar aur darar jaise pits. Tracheid: lambi patli gehri nali, nokeele ek doosre par charhe sire aur pits. Vessel: chauri khuli nali jis ki deewaron mein pits. Xylem parenchyma: teen zinda cells ka sutoon, har ek mein cytoplasm aur nucleus, aakhri deewaron mein pits. Labels: Fibre, Tracheid, Vessel, Xylem Parenchyma, Cytoplasm, Nucleus, Pit.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.8: Xylem tissue ke mukhtalif hisse (kitab ki Figure 8.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tracheids aur vessels murda khali naliyan hain jin se pani upar jata hai; pits se pani ek nali se doosri mein jata hai. Fibres sirf mazbooti dete hain. Xylem parenchyma hi zinda hissa hai, is liye sirf us mein nucleus aur cytoplasm dikhaye gaye hain; yeh khoorak aur pani zakheera karta hai.

Pani jaron se patton tak zyada tar xylem se jata hai. TACT mechanism (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) is baat ka aam taur par maana hua model hai ke pani kashish-e-saql (gravity) ke khilaf xylem se pode ke har hisse tak kaise jata hai; yeh pani ki tabee aur kimiyai khasoosiyat aur pode ke mahol se taalluq par munhasir hai.

items: Transpiration patton ki satah se, khaas kar stomata ke zariye, pani ka bukharat ban kar urna hai. Jaise pani ke bukharat patte se nikalte hain, patte ke tissue mein manfi dabao banta hai; yeh kheenchne wali quwwat pani ko jaron se tane ke raste patton ki taraf oopar kheenchti hai, is liye transpiration xylem mein pani ki naqal ki bunyadi quwwat hai.

Adhesion pani ke molecules aur xylem vessels ki deewaron ke darmiyan kashish hai. Pani ke molecules oopar jate hue deewaron se chipakte hain, jo pani ke column ko tootne se rokta aur use musalsal rakhta hai, khaas kar ooncha podon mein jahan gravity column ko zor se kheenchti hai.

Cohesion khud pani ke molecules ke darmiyan kashish ki quwwat hai, jo hydrogen bonding se hoti hai. Xylem mein pani ke molecules jaron se patton tak ek an-toota column bana kar aapas mein chipke rehte hain, is liye patte par transpiration se shuru hui kheench poore column tak pohnchti hai.

Tension patte par transpiration ki kheench se bana manfi dabao hai. Jaise pani patte ki satah se urta hai, kam dabao ka ilaqa xylem mein phailta hai, aur yeh tension cohesive pani ke column ko oopar kheenchti hai; pani ke musalsal chirhne ke liye yeh nihayat aham hai.

blocks.alt: Beech mein darakht aur baen taraf teen bare kiye hue dabbe. Patte ka dabba: mesophyll cells, xylem aur stoma, surkh teer xylem se stoma ke raste bahar; Transpiration draws water from the leaf. Tane ka dabba: xylem ke sutoon aur upar jate surkh teer; Cohesion and adhesion draw water up the xylem. Jar ka dabba: mitti ke zarre, pani ke molecules, root hair aur xylem, surkh teer andar; Negative water potential draws water into the root.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.9: Jar se patte tak pani ke bahao ka TACT mechanism (kitab ki Figure 8.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

Patte ka dabba: mesophyll cells, xylem aur stoma, surkh teer xylem se stoma ke raste bahar; Transpiration draws water from the leaf. Tane ka dabba: xylem ke sutoon aur upar jate surkh teer; Cohesion and adhesion draw water up the xylem. Daen taraf water potential gradient ka teer, neeche High se upar Low: Atmosphere taqreeban -100 MPa, patta -1.5 MPa, tana -0.6 MPa, jar ke cells -0.2 MPa.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani hamesha zyada water potential se kam water potential ki taraf jata hai. Jar (-0.2 MPa) se tana (-0.6), patta (-1.5) aur hawa (-100 MPa) tak qeemat musalsal ghatti hai, is liye pani khud ba khud upar khinchta hai. Patton se bukharat (transpiration) khinchao (tension) paida karta hai aur cohesion aur adhesion pani ke dhaage ko tootne nahin dete.

blocks.prompt: Ek darakht ke patton par aisa madda chhirka jata hai jo stomata band kar deta hai. TACT ki madad se batayein ke us ke xylem mein pani ke bahao ka kya hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Band stomata transpiration rok dete hain, to na bukharat nikalte hain aur na patte mein manfi dabao banta hai. Us tension ke baghair cohesive pani ke column ko oopar kheenchne wali koi cheez nahin; adhesion aur cohesion column ko salamat magar sakin rakhte hain, is liye xylem se pani ka oopar bahao bari had tak ruk jata hai.

items: Root hairs pani aur minerals lete hain; jar ke paar yeh apoplast (cell walls, endodermis par Casparian strip se band), symplast (plasmodesmata se cytoplasm) ya na-honay ke barabar vacuolar raste se jate hain.

Xylem: tracheids (nokeele, bordered pits), vessels (perforation plates ke saath sira-ba-sira), fibres (lignin wale, murda, sahara) aur parenchyma (zinda, zakheera, pehlu ki harkat, marammat). Banawati tissue bhi hai.
TACT: transpiration tension banati hai; deewaron se adhesion aur molecules ke darmiyan cohesion ek an-toota column rakhte hain jise tension jar se patte tak oopar kheenchti hai.
